description:
ROOT-CAUSE FIX. CallSiteSummary bundles membership-relevant content (targets[*].callee + targets[*].activation — stable, drives only 3 closure changes) with ascending type content (targets[*].surface_inputs, return_ty — semantic.rs:55-57, bump 945x). The fact has ONE revision, so every type-ascent re-wakes every membership subscriber (the seal). This false-sharing IS the ~270-fire wake-storm.

DO: introduce a CallSiteTargets fact (callee+activation edges per callsite) distinct from the ascending-type CallSiteSummary, published by AnalyzeActivation alongside the summary, whose revision bumps ONLY when targets change. Membership subscribers (the seal, seal.4) subscribe to CallSiteTargets; type consumers keep reading CallSiteSummary. Same identity/layout-split philosophy as ShapeId (see [[shapeid_is_pure_layout]]) and the addressed-arrow (fz-f98.14.10): separate stable membership identity from ascending type content into distinct fact revisions.

REMOVES: the false-sharing that drives the seal fires. THIS is what makes seal.4-6 correct (a presence-only seal would otherwise miss late-resolving targets). One commit.
title: [KEYSTONE] Split CallSiteTargets (membership edges) out of the type-laden CallSiteSummary
